summary.name: massCode
summary.one_liner: massCode is a free, open-source, local-first developer workspace for code snippets, Markdown notes, HTTP API requests, diagrams, and calculations.
use_cases: Keep technical notes linked to snippets and API requests
Test and chain HTTP API requests
Manage developer tasks with due dates
Run calculations with variables and unit conversions
summary.what_it_does: massCode stores code snippets, Markdown notes, HTTP requests, Excalidraw diagrams and math notebooks in a local vault of plain files. Notes can be shown as a link graph connecting them to related snippets and requests. An HTTP client runs saved requests in sequence, passes values between steps and shows test results. A built-in AI assistant can edit snippets and notes or work through HTTP workflows, using the user's own API key for cloud models or local models via Ollama or LM Studio. A command palette (⌘P) searches snippets, notes and requests.
notable: Local-first storage as plain Markdown and open-format files, works offline
Built-in AI assistant supporting OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and local models via Ollama or LM Studio, plus MCP for external AI agents
Sequential API workflow testing with value passing between steps
Sync via user's choice of iCloud, Dropbox, Syncthing or Git
caveats: Cloud AI model usage is billed by the provider through the user's own API key
Sending HTTP requests from the AI assistant requires user confirmation
Platforms beyond macOS are not named on the page; the listing mentions Homebrew install
